about: Development set for the review-screen aids (D-077): sentences of the kinds the reviewer trial planted (D-066), written fresh in new wording and not taken from the trial's plants. Each is inserted into an otherwise ordinary draft whose sources are fixed in tests/test_support_planted.py. A development set is for making changes; claims are made only on the rerun of the trial. SYNTHETIC DATA.
